Title: Current evaluation of amenorrhea: a committee opinion.
Abstract: The purpose of this American Society for Reproductive Medicine Practice Committee Opinion is to provide clinicians with principles and strategies for the diagnostic evaluation of patients presenting with primary or secondary amenorrhea.
